name: a standalone negated state is stored with status=active (negation lives in assertion only)
description: Adversarial negation-representation probe. A note negates a state with no prior fact on the key ('Cleo does NOT have a peanut allergy', assertion=negated). supersession.decide has no negation handling: with no existing fact it simply inserts, and the pipeline sets status=active. So a negated fact is a status=active row distinguished ONLY by assertion='negated'. Pins this representation explicitly: status alone does NOT encode truth — any consumer that filters on status='active' without also checking assertion will read this as 'Cleo HAS a peanut allergy', the exact inverse. (This is the structural root of the negation-then-reassert zombie in adv_negation_then_reassert: because negated facts are 'active', a later asserted re-statement of the same value is treated as identical and refreshed in place.) Asserts the active+negated row exists; documents the status/assertion coupling risk.
xfail: ACCEPTED, on measurement. assert_fact writes assertion='asserted' and has no field for anything else, so a negated, questioned, reported or hypothetical fact cannot be stated at all. Both spellings of a fix were probed against the live model through /api/debug/tool-probe (evals/shape_probe.py, `fields` suite, gpt-oss-120b, 12 samples an arm): an `assertion` STRING whose description names its five words came back legal 0 times in 72 - the model writes the fact's topic (`civic_sold`, `current_weight`, `dana works at everlane`) - and a `negated` BOOLEAN, the one closed vocabulary a tool grammar can carry without an enum (constraint 8), came back false 80 times out of 80, including every time on 'I finally sold the Civic last week so it is gone'. The string fills with garbage, the boolean fills with the majority class and never fires; neither is a channel. The future (`expected`) and past-marker (interval close) normalizers still fire - they are `_upsert_fact`'s own. The surviving channel is the owner's reply: `correct_fact` force-supersedes and pins. W5 MUST NOT DELETE: `facts.assertion` and its CHECK, `supersession.CURRENT_ASSERTIONS` / `_IRREALIS` and the negated-supersedes arm of decide(), or `extraction.ASSERTIONS` - the EMR importer and the reply turn both still write non-asserted rows, and the read surfaces filter on the column.

steps.body: Confirmed at the allergist: Cleo does NOT have a peanut allergy.

facts.statement: Cleo does not have a peanut allergy.
